name: ColorPicker

examples.title: Formats
examples.code:
<Columns>
  {(['hsl', 'hex', 'rgb'] as const).map(format => (
    <Column key={format} isNarrow>

    </Column>
  ))}
</Columns>

accessibility:
- **The square is one 2D slider made of two native range inputs**, saturation and brightness,
  the way React Aria builds it. Only the input for the axis moved last is a tab stop, and the
  other is hidden until a key moves it, so a screen reader lists one control, "Saturation and
  brightness, 2D slider", with value text such as "Saturation 50%, Brightness 80%", the moved
  channel first. On a touch device both inputs stay exposed, so a touch screen reader can adjust
  each with its own gestures.
- **Keys in the square:** the arrows move by 1, with Shift by 10; Page Up and Page Down move
  brightness by 10, and Home and End move saturation by 10. Focus follows the axis a key moved.
- **The sliders** are native range inputs named "Hue" and "Alpha", read as "171 degrees" and
  "50%". The arrows step by 1, with Shift or Page Up and Page Down by 10, and Home and End go to
  the ends.
- **Right to left,** the horizontal arrows follow the screen.
- **Pointer:** a press anywhere on the square or a track sets the value there, so nothing needs a
  drag (WCAG 2.5.7), and the sliders, the square and the swatch buttons are at least 24 by 24 CSS
  pixels (WCAG 2.5.8).
- **Swatches** are a radio group named "Swatches": each swatch is a radio named by its label or
  its color, the chosen one checked and marked by a check and a ring as well as its color.
- **The value is always in words:** the field shows it and takes a typed color, and a value it
  can't read is marked invalid and put back when you leave the field.
- **The group** is named by its `label`, or by `aria-label`.
- **Strings** come from `labels`, with English defaults.
- **Forced colors:** the square, the tracks and the swatches keep their colors with an edge in the
  system's text color, and the chosen swatch's ring is drawn in the system's highlight color.
- **The eye dropper** button is named "Pick a color from the screen" and only appears where the
  browser can do it.
summary: The `ColorPicker` component is a panel for choosing a color: a saturation and brightness square, a hue slider, and the value as text, with alpha and swatches when asked for. Every part is operable by keyboard, and the square is two native range inputs, one per axis, with one tab stop. The value is a CSS color string in `format`, HSL by default.

parts.summary: The `ColorPicker` component is a panel for choosing a color: a saturation and brightness square, a hue slider, and the value as text, with alpha and swatches when asked for. Every part is operable by keyboard, and the square is two native range inputs, one per axis, with one tab stop. The value is a CSS color string in `format`, HSL by default.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label naming the picker's group, through `aria-labelledby`. Dropped inside an outer `Field`, whose own label names it instead. An `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` you set wins over either.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `id` here is used as the `aria-labelledby` target instead of a generated one; any `htmlFor` is ignored (a group label names the group, never a single control).

props.name: value
props.description: The color, controlled: any CSS color the picker reads (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()` or a color name), in any format, since `onChange` hands back the `format` asked for. One it can't read leaves the picker showing the last color it could. A value it gave you comes back without moving the thumbs, and a gray or black keeps the hue and saturation the user had.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The color to start with, uncontrolled. Black without one.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the color, in `format`, as it changes: on every step of a drag, and on a key, a swatch, a typed value or the eye dropper.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called with the color, in `format`, once a change is done: when a drag ends, and with `onChange` for a key, a swatch, a typed value or the eye dropper. The place to save it.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is written: `'hsl'` (`hsl(171, 100%, 41%)`), Bulma's own color space and what `Theme`'s `primaryH`, `primaryS` and `primaryL` take, `'hex'` (`#00d1b2`) or `'rgb'` (`rgb(0, 209, 178)`). With `alpha`, `hsla()`, `#rrggbbaa` and `rgba()`.

props.name: alpha
props.description: Adds an alpha slider and writes the alpha into the value. Without it, the value is always solid.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colors shown as a radio group under the picker: a list of CSS colors, each a string or `{ color, label }`, or `"bulma"` for the page's primary, link, info, success, warning and danger, read from Bulma's CSS variables once the picker is on the page, so a themed app shows its own. The `"bulma"` names are English; for others, pass the list yourself, such as `{ color: 'var(--bulma-primary)', label: 'Primär' }`.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Adds a button that picks a color from anywhere on the screen, where the browser has the EyeDropper API (desktop Chromium today). Elsewhere, and until the page hydrates, it isn't shown.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every part. A disabled `Fieldset` around it does too.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. When set, a hidden input carries the value.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form the hidden input belongs to.

props.name: labels
props.description: The strings it says, each with an English default.

props.name: children
props.description: Parts for a layout of your own: `ColorPicker.Area`, `ColorPicker.HueSlider`, `ColorPicker.AlphaSlider`, `ColorPicker.Swatches` and `ColorPicker.Input`, with anything else between them. Without children, the picker shows the square, the hue slider, the alpha slider with `alpha`, the value, and the swatches when there are some.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label (used in horizontal layouts).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Horizontal field layout.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation message below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Bulma color for the message.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

extraProps.name: aria-label
extraProps.description: Names the picker's group when there's no `label`.
